detail: Every message read, sorted and answered where the answer is already written down.
From the pull requests that actually shipped, in the voice the last ten entries used.
Flags the page that contradicts the one you just changed, before a customer finds it.
The eleventh time somebody asks where the runbook is, it answers instead of you.
Knows who owns the decision, asks them once, and closes the note when they reply.
One page on Friday: what moved, what slipped, and the note nobody picked up.
